header.name: [bedrock-research]inventory-ui-enhanced-components-bp_v1.0.0
header.description: v1.0.0 - Seventeen enhanced components drawn in an entity chest screen: on-screen keyboards, a color picker, charts, real item grids, a live player figure, server-built tables and trees, a countdown and a drag-drawn pattern lock. Every press goes to the server as a slot button and the server answers through slot names. Works next to the other entity inventory examples. Use the Inventory UI Enhanced Components item.
